<thought>Use a simple, valid Si CIF string (diamond structure) to enumerate all possible (1,1,1) surface slab terminations with default slab and vacuum sizes. Then write the returned JSON to a file named slabs.json and output its path.</thought>
<action>enumerate_slabs_text</action>

  "min_slab_size": 12,
  "min_vacuum_size": 5
}
